description.value: Romano's Pizza is a pizza restaurant on Granville Street in central Vancouver specializing in fresh handmade pizzas built with natural, organic, and local ingredients. The menu spans meat, veggie, and Turkish food categories, with accommodations for vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free diets. Outdoor seating and online ordering make it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists moving through the downtown core.
